Incremental policy ruleset chunk from file '04_agentic_guardrails.md' (1-based global rule indices 51–60).

Rules in this chunk:
51. A call to initiate a dispute of type SECTION_75 requires that the referenced transaction has its section seventy five eligibility flag set to true.
52. A call to initiate a dispute of type SECTION_75 requires that the referenced transaction amount is at least ten thousand pence and at most thirty million pence.
53. A call to initiate a dispute of type UNAUTHORIZED requires that the referenced transaction's days since posted is at most one hundred twenty.
54. A call to initiate a dispute of type GOODS_NOT_RECEIVED requires that the referenced transaction's days since posted is at least fifteen.
55. A call to initiate a dispute of type DUPLICATE_CHARGE requires that the referenced transaction's has duplicate candidate within window flag is set to true.
56. A call to initiate a dispute is not permitted if the customer's recent dispute count exceeds ten unless the dispute type is UNAUTHORIZED.
57. A call to initiate a dispute is not permitted if the customer's KYC status is FAILED.
58. A call to cancel a dispute requires that the dispute exists and has status OPEN or UNDER_REVIEW.
59. A call to cancel a dispute is not permitted if the dispute has status APPROVED, REJECTED, ESCALATED, or WITHDRAWN.
60. A call to freeze a card requires that the card exists.
